snippet.title: Metromino - Announcement Trailer | Tetromino City Builder
snippet.description:
Build your city, one piece at a time.

Metromino is a casual city-building game where you build your city using tetromino-shaped pieces.

Place buildings and roads, develop your neighborhoods, provide essential city services, and watch your small town grow into a thriving metropolis.

The demo is coming soon!

Wishlist Metromino on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5316210/Metromino/
